description: Revert to the proven 8-layer architecture and restore the specific hyperparameters (Matrix LR=0.11, Embedding LR=1.4) that yielded the best val_bpb of 0.9891, as the current configuration (Matrix LR=0.08, Embedding LR=1.2) is under-training and previous attempts to fine-tune around the optimum have consistently resulted in worse performance due to instability or insufficient convergence speed.
